items.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a complete 3:2 Chinese xianxia sect city background for a browser game, 1536 by 1024. Create one integrated high-resolution detailed pixel-art isometric floating-island city, all terrain and architecture coherently composed in one image, matching modern indie detailed pixel art. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters, limited teal-gray, jade, ivory stone, warm brown wood and restrained gold palette, careful pixel dithering, consistent warm afternoon sunlight from the upper left and cool shadows. Three-quarter elevated isometric camera with visible architectural side faces and platform thickness. EXACTLY SEVEN distinct complete functional building groups, no more and no fewer. Keep each group visually separate, unobstructed, not overlapping other roofs, fully inside the frame, linked by white-jade stone paths to one open central white-jade plaza at image center (50 percent x, 52 percent y). Positions are building-group centers measured from top left: 1. scripture library at (20 percent x, 27 percent y), elegant scholarly pavilion with visible bookshelves and scrolls, clearly for disciple study and recruitment; 2. dignified sect administrative main hall at (50 percent x, 25 percent y), widest ceremonial double-eaved hall with broad white-jade steps and red wooden pillars, not a gate or tavern; 3. harbor at (83 percent x, 25 percent y), one small dock office pavilion attached to a wooden pier and exactly one moored Chinese sailing boat; 4. martial drill courtyard at (20 percent x, 59 percent y), open training arena with weapon racks and wooden training dummies, no enclosed house; 5. tall slender seven-story trial pagoda at (81 percent x, 59 percent y), clearly the tallest vertical landmark, entirely visible and not cropped; 6. artifact smithy at (40 percent x, 79 percent y), compact stone-and-wood forge workshop with one anvil, a red glowing forge opening and short chimney; 7. alchemy house at (62 percent x, 79 percent y), herb shelves and a bronze pill furnace with faint jade-green smoke, visually distinct from the smithy. All seven groups use harmonious dark-teal tile roofs and warm wooden details, firmly grounded with correct contact shadows and consistent perspective. Architecture occupies the inner approximately 70 percent of the image; keep an outer approximately 15 percent border of cloud sea, rocky floating-island edge and distant mountains so roofs and boats are not cut off. A few golden ginkgo and pink blossom trees may sit in gaps without concealing building silhouettes or the open center. No extra buildings, no tavern, no inn, no marketplace, no market stalls, no quest board, no signboards, no eighth building, no additional towers. No people, no UI, no labels, no text, no watermark, no logos, no border, no floating building sprites.
